c5_q7_program.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    broccolis = image_patch.find("broccoli")
    mickey_mouses = image_patch.find("mickey mouse")
    chickens = image_patch.find("chicken")

    if not broccolis or not mickey_mouses or not chickens:
        return image_patch

    closest_mickey_mouse = min(mickey_mouses, key=lambda mm: mm.compute_depth())
    closest_chicken = min(chickens, key=lambda ch: ch.compute_depth())

    broccolis_by_mickey_mouse = [b for b in broccolis if is_between_3d(b, closest_mickey_mouse, closest_chicken)]

    if not broccolis_by_mickey_mouse:
        return image_patch

    return broccolis_by_mickey_mouse[0]
